entity.summary: Open-source non-custodial multichain Web3 browser wallet built by the team behind MyEtherWallet.
entity.notes: Enkrypt is modeled as a distinct wallet/project identity despite being built by the MEW team because it is separately branded, distributed and maintained as a multichain browser wallet. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Enkrypt non-custodial open-source multichain browser-extension wallet.
products.notes: Current first-party Enkrypt site explicitly distributes the extension across multiple browsers. Exact initial extension release date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: About Enkrypt
evidence.notes: First-party Enkrypt page identifies Enkrypt as a distinct multichain, non-custodial, open-source Web3 browser wallet built by the MEW team.

evidence.title: Enkrypt: Ethereum, Polkadot and Bitcoin Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site explicitly distributes Enkrypt as a non-custodial browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Opera and Safari.

evidence.title: Enkrypt
evidence.notes: Current first-party Enkrypt site distributes the extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Opera and Safari and describes ongoing multichain support.
